description: Re-elect Doreen Carter | State Representative House District 93! She is a proven leader, financial expert, and advocate for economic equity who has dedicated her life to public service, faith, and financial empowerment. A lifelong Georgian and proud resident of Lithonia, Rep. Carter currently serves in the Georgia House of Representatives, representing House District 93—which includes portions of DeKalb, Rockdale, and Gwinnett counties.
title: Re-elect Doreen Carter | GA District 93
